summary: The Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K reporting its firm-commitment IPO. On April 22, 2026, it entered an underwriting agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald to sell 8,571,428 shares at $14.00/share, raising ~$138M gross proceeds. The underwriters fully exercised the over-allotment option for an additional 1,285,714 shares on April 23. The offering closed on April 24, 2026, with net proceeds of ~$125.5M. The common stock trades on Nasdaq under ELMT. This is a routine IPO, not a special situation. The filing is standard disclosure of a capital-raising event with no structural complexity or event-driven angle.
